text.p: MedPartners Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to merge with InPhyNet Medical Management Inc in a deal valued at $493 million.
The combined company will have $5.2 billion in revenues and be the largest provider of full time hospital-based physician services, MedPartners said.
The company said the agreement has been approved by the boards of both companies.
The pact calls for each InPhyNet share to be converted at a fixed ratio of 1.311 shares of MedPartners common stock, MedPartners said.
The ratio, based on MedPartners' closing price of $22, implies a value of $28.84 per share of InPhyNet, the company said.

MedPartners said it expects the deal to close near the end of the first quarter if shareholders approve it. The transaction would be tax-free to InPhyNet stockholders and accounted for as a pooling of interests, the company said.

MedPartners is the largest physician practice management company in the nation, operating physician practices in 25 states. Its also operates the country's largest independent prescription benefits management service.
